claim_one_line: PHASE 2'S CONCESSIONS, V2: TWO DEFECTS FIXED, THEN TWO BLOCKERS ON THE FIX ITSELF -- CONCEDED AND PINNED OPEN, the second correction arriving from cc3 BEFORE the batch banked. ROUND 2, cc3's two blockers on the pin, both verified on this bench: BLOCKER 1 -- B782's torsor bits (conjugation, reversal, golden branch) and B936's (Z/2)^2 frame classes (indexed by E6's tau-fixed Dynkin nodes {1,3}) have DIFFERENT INDEXINGS and NO ARC IDENTIFIES THEM; same cardinality is not the same bits; R11 v2 states the discrete deficit as 2 <= d <= 4 pending L153 (the identification cell, cc's lane). BLOCKER 2, THE RUN'S FIRST TWO-SEAT FINDING: the T2 license 'B1012 proves the object cannot fix sigma' is WITHDRAWN on two verified grounds -- B1012 proves k-blindness ONLY and its own formula gives dS/dsigma = -Vol != 0 (the object is SIGHTED in sigma), and sigma = 1 is a candidate FORCED value: c((E6)_1) = 78/13 = 6 = B254's banked conformal-embedding split 16/5 + 14/5, with c = 6 sigma (arithmetic re-verified here). A2's permission rests on the unit freedom + B915's precedent alone pending L154, whose stakes are stated plainly: IF THE GRAVITATIONAL sigma AND THE STAGE'S sigma ARE ONE, c = 6 IS DERIVED AND THE INPUT LIST SHRINKS BY ITS ONLY CONTINUOUS DIMENSIONLESS MEMBER; if different, a third terminology collision (two sigmas, after two conductors and two levels). The sealed DECLARATION stays byte-identical; its two wrong lines are corrected in the addendum v2 beside it. SURVIVES ALL ROUNDS: the Gate-5 re-anchor; the two-functors distinction; the sealed-file pattern (locked); the structure-sector counter to C5 (sustained, unchallenged); and the open lane improves again -- coupling to mixing consumes NEITHER anchor type under every branch of L153/L154. SCORING: round 1 cc3 +2 conceded; round 2 NOT scored per cc3's own ruling (a defect in a fix to a defect is the process working); blocker 2 could not have been produced by any single seat -- chat1's derivation x cc3's re-verification x cc's text -- the three-seat design's first demonstrable return over its cost.
